setting: walking down the hill from the hospital at quarter past eight on the first hard frost, boots on grit, breath very close on the microphone, a gritting lorry passing halfway, two long pauses and a short laugh at nothing

her classroom at ten to four on the last day of term, chairs already on the tables, the big window open, a caretaker's trolley going past in the corridor, her voice low and unhurried against the room's echo
his kitchen mid afternoon, a pan at a low simmer with a lid rattling once, a spoon set down on the hob, the extractor fan under everything, one sentence delivered entirely flat
the walk home on Christmas morning, no traffic at all, one distant church bell, his footsteps very clear on the empty road, a long silence in the middle before he starts again
a train seat late on a winter afternoon, rails under everything, a trolley two carriages away, her voice half swallowed by her coat collar, the last few words spoken as the train goes into a cutting
